description: Use when the user asks Intakra to find companies, and ask first. Requests account suggestions from a short description, an industry, a size range, a country, or up to 5 customer domains. Runs in the background; results arrive later as suggestions (list_suggestions) and never count toward the plan until approved. A few requests a day at most.

country.description: Two letter country code, for example US

description.description: For example "logistics software companies in Texas"

lookalike_domains.description: Up to 5 customer domains to find lookalikes of

name: request_accounts

status.description: queued when the request was accepted.

title: Find accounts for me
